title: Coefficient lift preserves homology of etale abelian sheaves
statement: For every scheme X in universe u, with small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], the coefficient lift functor sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u+1,u} preserves homology. In particular it preserves the homology of each short complex and sends quasi-isomorphisms of cochain complexes to quasi-isomorphisms.

source.place: Step 3, exactness of coefficient lift. Formal implementation uses Mathlib CategoryTheory/Sites/EpiMono and CategoryTheory/Abelian/Exact.

proof.text: The coefficient lift is additive: on morphisms its additivity equation is definitional. The inclusion of sheaves into presheaves creates limits, and whiskering by the group ULift functor preserves limits. The composite preserves parallel-pair limits, and reflection of limits by the sheaf inclusion therefore gives preservation of kernels by coefficient lift.

A morphism of abelian sheaves is epi exactly when locally surjective (Mathlib Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi'). For a lifted section s, the image sieve of the lifted morphism equals the original image sieve of s.down: witnesses correspond by ULift.up and ULift.down. Thus lift preserves local surjectivity and epimorphisms. Apply Mathlib Functor.preservesHomology_of_preservesEpis_and_kernels. This proof includes the empty scheme and zero sheaf without further hypotheses.

mathlib_searches.query: Universe lift of abelian sheaves preserves homology and injective objects
The universe lift of an injective abelian sheaf on a small site is injective
mathlib_searches.results: ModuleCat.ulift_injective_of_injective is for modules, not sheaves. General Grothendieck-abelian sheaf results do not preserve injective objects across coefficient universes.
No sheaf coefficient-lift theorem. Mathlib group ULift preserves limits and colimits. Exactness reduces to kernel preservation and local surjectivity.
